spans.s: निकक्ष नि-कक्ष, अस्, m., Ved. the armpit.

निकट नि-कट, अस्, आ, अम्, situated at the
side, near, proximate, close by; without neighbours,
kinless?; (अस्, अम्), m. n. proximity; (ए), ind. in
the neighbourhood, at hand.
—निकटी-भूत, अस्, आ,
अम्, approached.

निकथित नि-कथित, अस्, आ, अम्, told, re-
lated (?).
निकथितिन्, ई, इनी, इ, one who has told.

निकम् नि-कम्, cl. 10. A. -कामयते, -च-
कमे, &c., to long for, wish for, have a desire for,
lust after (with acc.).

नि-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. desirous of, longing
for, vehemently desiring, (often at the beginning of
a comp. in the sense of नि-कामम्, ind.); (अस्), m.
desire, wish; (अम्), ind. according to wish or desire,
willingly, according to pleasure or to one's satisfaction,
to one's heart's content; यदा निकामम्, if you
please, if you like.
—निकाम-काम, अस्, आ, अम्,
covetous.
—निकाम-वर्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, raining ac-
cording to wish.
नि-कामन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. desirous of, longing for.
नि-कामन, अम्, n. desire, longing after.

नि-कामयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, longing for, wish-
ing for.

निकर नि-कर, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. कॄ with नि),
a heap, pile; a flock or multitude; a bundle; pith,
sap, essence; suitable gift, a honorarium; a treasure,
the best of anything, a treasure belonging to Kuvera.

1. नि-कार, अस्, m. piling up or winnowing corn;
tossing or lifting up.

निकार 1. and 2. नि-कार. For 1. see above;
for 2. see under नि-कृ, p. 483, col. 1.

2. नि-कार, अस्, m. putting down, bringing down,
humiliation, subjugation; injury, insult, wrong, offence;
wickedness, malice, abuse, reproach, disrespect; op-
position, contradiction.

नीकार नी-कार, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. कृ with
नि), disrespect, contempt, vilifying, degrading.

निकष नि-कष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. कष् for
कर्ष् = कृष् with नि), the touchstone, the streak
of gold or test made on it [cf. नि-काष]; (आ), f., N.
of the mother of Rāvaṇa or of the mother of the
Piśitāśana fiends or imps in general.
—निकषात्-
मज (˚षा-आत्˚), अस्, m. a Rākṣasa, a sort of
demon; [cf. कषा-पुत्र.]

नि-कषा, ind. near to (with acc.), proximate;
in the middle, betwixt, between (with acc.).

निकस नि-कस, निकसात्मज = नि-कष and
निकषात्मज, q. v.

निकाश नि-काश, अस्, m. (fr. rt. काश् with नि),
[]
the horizon; appearance, sight; (at the end of an
adj. comp.) having the appearance of, similar, like;
[cf. नी-काश.]
निकास नि-कास = नि-काश, नी-काश.

नीकाश नी-काश, अस्, m. (fr. rt. काश् with नि),
[]
appearance, look, air, mien; certainty, ascertainment;
(अस्, आ, अम्), like, resembling, (at the end of comps.)
निकाष = निकष, the touchstone.
नि-कषण, अम्, n. (?), the touchstone.

निकषाय, Nom. A. निकषायते, &c., to be
used or serve as a touchstone.

निकाणम् नि-काणम्, ind. (fr. rt. कण् with
नि), having closed the eyes; निकाणम् अक्षि जल्-
पति or अक्षि-निकाणं जल्पति, he speaks with
closed eyes.

निकाय नि-काय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. चि with नि),
a heap, an assemblage, a group, class, association or
set of persons who perform like duties; a congre-
gation, a school; a flock, multitude in general; a
house, dwelling-place, habitation, hiding-place; the
body; (according to Mahī-dhara) the air, wind
(Ved.); a butt, aim, mark; the universal Soul,
Supreme Being.
—निकायान्तरीय (˚य-अन्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, belonging to another assemblage or school.
नि-काय्य, अस्, अम्, m. n. (?), a dwelling, house.

नि-कायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, an epithet of particular oblations
or sacrifices.
निकारिन् नि-कारिन्. See p. 483, col. 1.
नि-कारिन्, ई, m., Ved. an injurer, oppressor.

निकावल्गा निकावल्गा, f., N. of a woman,
(perhaps rather two names, निका and वल्गा.)

निकाषम् नि-काषम्, ind. having pounded
or mixed together.

निकिल्बिष नि-किल्बिष, अम्, n., Ved. freeing
from sin, deliverance from evil.

निकुचिति नि-कुचिति, इस्, f. (fr. rt. कुञ्च् with
नि), contraction ?; [cf. Pāṇ.
निकुच्य-कर्णि, ind. with the ears hanging down.

नि-कुञ्चक, अस्, m. a measure of capacity equal
to (1/4) of a Kuḍava; a species of reed (= वानीर).
नि-कुञ्चित, अस्, आ, अम्, contracted.

निकुञ्ज नि-कुञ्ज, अस्, अम्, m. n. = कुञ्ज, an
arbour, a bower, a place overgrown with shrubs and
creepers, a thicket.

निकुञ्जिकाम्ला (˚का-अम्˚), f. a species of plant
(= कुञ्जिका, कुञ्ज-वल्लरी).

निकुम्भ नि-कुम्भ, अस्, m. the plant Croton
Polyandrum; N. of a Dānava who, like Kumbha,
was son of Pra-hlāda, (he was father of Sunda and
Upa-sunda); N. of a Rakṣas; of a son of Kumbha-
karṇa; of an attendant of Śiva; of one of Skanda's
attendants; N. of one of the Viśve Devāḥ, (also
read विस्कुम्भु); N. of a hero on the side of the
Kurus; N. of a king of Ayodhyā, son of Hary-aśva
and father of Saṃhatāśva; (ई), f. the plant Croton
Polyandrum.
—निकुम्भाख्य-जीव (˚भ-आख्˚),
अम्, n. a plant, Croton Jamalgota (= जय-पाल).
नि-कुम्भित, अम्, n. a kind of time in music.

नि-कुम्भिला, f. (fr. कुम्भ, a jar?), a place
where oblations are offered; a grove at the western
gate of Laṅkā for the performance of sacrificial rites;
(according to another commentator) an image of
Bhadra-kālī on the west side of Laṅkā; (also,
according to some, नि-कुम्भिलस्, m., and नि-कुम्-
भिलम्, n.)

निकुरुम्ब नि-कुरुम्ब or नि-कुरुम्बक, अम्,
n. a flock, mass, multitude; (also read नि-कुरम्ब,
-नि-कुरूम्ब, नि-कुरुम्भ.)

निकुलीनिका नि-कुलीनिका, f. a family art or
one inherited by birth, any skill or skilful act pecu-
liar to a race.

निकूल नि-कूल, अस्, आ, अम्, going down
hill, (opposed to उत्-कूल); standing on a declivity
or bank.

निकृ नि-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते,
-कर्तुम्, Ved. to put down, bring down, lower,
humiliate, subdue, overcome, overpower, depreciate,
debase; to act in a low or base manner, to treat ill;
(in the post-Vedic literature only occurring in the
past part. नि-कृत, q. v.): Desid. नि-चिकीर्षति, to
wish to subdue.

नि-कर्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be acted badly or
basely, to be injured; (अस्माकं तैर् निकर्तव्यम्,
a wrong is to be done us by them.)
नि-कारण, अम्, n. killing, slaughter.

नि-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, brought down, lowered,
cast down, humbled, humiliated; insulted, offended;
afflicted; injured; tricked, cheated, deceived; re-
moved, set aside, dismissed; dishonest, wicked, per-
verse; low, base, vile; (अम्), n. lowering, humbling,
humiliation; (also read नि-कृति.)
—निकृत-प्रज्ञ,
अस्, आ, अम्, evil-minded.
—निकृत-मति, इस्, इस्, इ,
depraved in mind.

नि-कृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, cut off, cut up.
—निकृत्त-
मूल, अस्, आ, अम्, cut up by the roots.

नि-कृति, इस्, f. low conduct, baseness, wicked-
ness, dishonest practice, dishonesty, fraud, deception,
[]
deceit, cheating; offence, insult; abuse, reproach;
rejection, removal; poverty, indigence; wickedness,
a wicked person (personified as a daughter of
A-dharma and Hiṃsā, or Nirṛti); (इस्, इस्, इ),
base, low, dishonest, wicked; (इस्), m., N. of one
of the eight Vasus.
—निकृति-प्रज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्,
versed in dishonesty, well acquainted with vice.

निकृतिन्, ई, इनी, इ (fr. नि-कृत), = नि-कृति, dis-
honest, low, base, wicked.

नि-कृत्या, f. wickedness, dishonesty, fraud, &c.,
= नि-कृति.
नि-कृत्वन्, आ, अरी, अ, Ved. acting basely, deceitful.

निकृत् नि-कृत्, cl. 6. P. -कृन्तति, -कर्तितुम्,
to cut down, hew down, cut away, cut or chop off,
cut through, cut asunder, cut to pieces, massacre;
tear off, tear away, wear away; A. (-ते), to cut one-
self (or one's nails &c.); to cut down &c.: Caus.
-कर्तयति, &c., to cause to cut or cut down.

नि-कर्तन, अम्, n. cutting down, cutting to
pieces, cutting off.

नि-कृन्तन, अस्, ई, अम्, cutting down, cutting
off, destroying; (अस्), m., N. of a hell; (अम्), n.
massacring, cutting, cutting off, destruction; an in-
strument for cutting.

निकृष् नि-कृष्, cl. 1. 6. P. -कर्षति, -कृ-
षति, -कर्ष्टुम् or -क्रष्टुम्, to draw down,
drag down; to tear asunder (?). In Mahā-bh. 1.
3616. नि-कृष्यते may mean ‘is drawn down by
the stream of a river.’

नि-कर्षण, अम्, n. an open space for recreation,
a sort of play-ground in or near a town; a court at
the entrance of a house; a neighbourhood.

नि-कृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, debased, low, base, vile,
vulgar; despised, outcast; near; (अम्), n. vicinity,
proximity.
—निकृष्टाशय (˚ट-आश्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
having base intentions.
—निकृष्टाशय-ता, f. the
state of one who has base intentions, base disposition
of mind; jealousy.
—निकृष्टोपाधि-ता (˚ट-उप्˚),
f. a state of base or low deception.

निकेचाय नि-केचाय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. चि with
नि), piling or collecting repeatedly.

निकेत नि-केत or नि-केतक, अस्, m. = केतन,
a house, mansion, habitation; a mark, countersign.

निकेतन नि-केतन, अस्, m. an onion; (अम्),
n. = नि-केत, a house, mansion, abode, habitation,
temple.

निकोचक नि-कोचक, अस्, m. (fr. rt. कुञ्च्
with नि), the tree Alangium Decapetalum; (अम्),
n. the fruit of this tree.

नि-कोचन, अम्, n. contracting, contraction, com-
pression.

निकोठक नि-कोठक, अस्, m. = नि-कोचक
above.

निकोथक नि-कोथक, अस्, m. (fr. rt. कुथ् with
नि), N. of a teacher with the epithet Bhāyajātya.

निकोश्य नि-कोश्य, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?),
Ved. a particular part of the entrails of sacrificial
animals; [cf. कोश्य.]
निक्तहस्त निक्त-हस्त. See rt. निज्, p. 485.

निक्रन्द् नि-क्रन्द्, cl. 1. P. -क्रन्दति, -क्रन्-
दितुम्, Ved. to utter a cry in a direction downwards
(as a bird on a tree): Caus. -क्रन्दयति, -यितुम्,
Ved. to cause to roar &c.

निक्रम् नि-क्रम्, cl. 1. P. -क्रामति, -क्र-
मितुम्, to set the foot on the ground, put down the
feet; to enter; to tread down (with acc.)

नि-क्रमण, अम्, n., Ved. putting down the feet,
treading down; the place where the foot is put,
foot-step, foot-fall.

निक्रीड् नि-क्रीड्, Caus. -क्रीडयति, &c., to
play, sport.

नि-क्रीड, अस्, m. play, sport; मरुतां निक्रीडः,
N. of a Sāman.

निक्वण नि-क्वण or नि-क्वाण, अस्, m. a
musical tone or sound; any sound.

निक्ष् निक्ष्, cl. 1. P. निक्षति, &c., to
pierce (Ved.); to kiss.
निक्षण, अम्, n. kissing.

नीक्षण नीक्षण, अम्, n. (fr. rt. ईक्ष् with नि
or rt. निक्ष्?), Ved. a stick for stirring up a caldron,
a kind of ladle, (Sāy. = पाक-परीक्षा-साधनं
काष्ठम्); [cf. नेक्षण.]

निक्षा निक्षा, f. a nit; (a wrong form for
लिक्षा.)

निक्षिप् नि-क्षिप्, cl. 6. P. A. -क्षिपति, -ते,
-क्षेप्तुम्, to throw down, cast or put down, throw
upon, put or lay down; put in, pour in; to deliver
anything (acc.) to a person (loc.); to give or hand
over, grant; to deposit, commit, deliver to any one's
charge, intrust; to install, appoint, establish; to lay
aside, give up, leave off, cast off, repel; to encamp:
Caus. -क्षेपयति, &c., to cause to put down, to
cause to be set down in writing.

नि-क्षिपत्, अन्, अन्ती or अती, अत्, throwing down
or on, placing in or upon.

नि-क्षिप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown down or upon,
put down, laid down or on, placed into, thrust into;
deposited, pawned, pledged; rejected, abandoned,
foregone, given or thrown away; sent, sent off or
away.
—निक्षिप्त-वाद, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has
ceased talking or left off boasting.

नि-क्षिप्य, ind. having placed or laid down or
upon; having given in charge, having intrusted or
deposited in a place of safety.

नि-क्षेप, अस्, m. throwing upon, casting on
(with loc.); a deposit, pledge, trust, anything de-
posited without a seal in trust or as a compensation,
anything pawned; abandoning, parting with, throw-
ing away; sending or putting away; wiping, drying;
in निक्षेप-लिपि probably N. of a country; [cf.
उत्-क्षेप, प्र-क्षेप, वि-क्षेप.]

नि-क्षेपण, अम्, n. putting down (the feet); a
means by which or place in which anything is kept.

नि-क्षेपित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to be put down
or set down in writing, committed to writing, in-
scribed.

नि-क्षेप्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, who or what places or
deposits, delivers to one's care; (ता), m. a depositor,
a pawner or pledger.

नि-क्षेप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be deposited, to be
thrust into.

निक्षुभा नि-क्षुभा, f. (fr. rt. क्षुभ् with
नि), N. of the mother of Maga.

निक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, washed, cleaned, cleansed,
rinsed; sprinkled.
—निक्त-हस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
clean-handed, having clean hands.

नीक, अस्, m. a species of tree; (आ), f. a channel
for irrigation.

नीकर्षिन् नी-कर्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ (fr. rt. कृष्
with नि), spreading the tail (as a peacock ?).
नीकुलक नीकुलक, अस्, m., N. of a man.

नीक्लेद नी-क्लेद, अस्, m. (fr. rt. क्लिद् with नि),
moistening, bedewing (?), Pāṇ.
, Schol.
